purpose: Monte Carlo stability of the percentile bootstrap for intervals whose decision-relevant bound sits within ~1 pp of its threshold. Re-runs the SAME estimand on the SAME episodes at seven RNG seeds and once at 200,000 resamples. A bound that changes sign across seeds is Monte Carlo noise, not a result.

pooled_t_depth_m9_m11.goal_pass.scenario.verdict: FRAGILE - sign flips across seeds (seed 3 gives a negative lower bound). Must not be reported as resolved.

pooled_ni_ceiling_minus_t_m11.goal_pass..verdict: STABLE - negative at every seed. The secondary clustering does exclude zero; the primary (scenario) does not, so the reported verdict is unchanged.

pooled_ni_ceiling_minus_zs_m11.tgc.scena.verdict: STABLE AT AN ATOM - identical at every seed because TGC is discrete and the 97.5th percentile lands on the same attainable value. Stable, but it fails the 7.00 margin by 0.0175 pp, which no amount of resampling can adjudicate.

did01_m11_narration_x_receiver.goal_pass.verdict: STABLE - strictly positive at every seed and at 200k. DID-01 survives the probe.
